summary.text: Paul McMurtry is a Democratic state representative from the 11th Norfolk District who has held the seat since 2007 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He owns the Dedham Community Theater.

paragraphs.text: McMurtry's professional experience includes working as owner of the Dedham Community Theater, and he earned a bachelor's degree from Northeastern University.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Joint Committee on Labor and Workforce Development, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of other joint committees in earlier sessions, including Community Development and Small Businesses in 2023-2024 and Veterans and Federal Affairs in 2021-2022.
